intro.h2: Marble Work Made in a Farmington Shop
paragraphs: Majestic Marble builds marble shower surrounds in Farmington from a shop at 2801 La Plata Hwy. Homeowners talk it over with Dennis on the phone, come in to look at samples, and then he installs the finished pieces on site.

Reviewers keep coming back to how the work is made and how problems get handled. When one customer's shower walls turned out to be out of square and the pan had a small casting defect, Dennis cast a new pan to fit at the shop's own cost. Another customer wrote about the artistry that goes into the mixing. A third ended up with a gorgeous surround for a fraction of the price of tile.

items.name: Shower surrounds
items.blurb: Shower surrounds are the job reviewers mention most. You talk through the space, choose from samples at the shop, and the surround is installed on site. One Farmington customer said the result was a gorgeous shower surround for a fraction of the price of tile.

process.h2: From Phone Call to Finished Shower

steps.title: Talk it over
steps.text: Call (505) 326-2447 and describe your shower or tub. Dennis consults on the phone so you know what the project involves.

steps.title: Look at samples
steps.text: Visit the shop at 2801 La Plata Hwy on a weekday between 8 AM and 4:30 PM to see samples and pick a look.

steps.title: Measure and make
steps.text: The space is measured and the pieces are made for it. Mention uneven floors or out of square walls early so they can be planned for.

steps.title: Install on site
steps.text: Dennis installs the pieces in your home. Reviewers say that when something is off, it gets fixed properly rather than covered with caulk.

gallery.h2: Showers and Baths by Majestic Marble

items.name: Cody J.
items.text: Dennis has been lovely to work with, consulting on the phone, looking at samples in his shop and on site installing. Our shower walls were out of square, which was not caught in the measurement phase. There were also some high/ low spots in our sub floor and there was a minor defect in the casting of the shower pan. Dennis could have easily caulked it all in and I would have been none the wiser. Instead, he cast a new pan to fit, costing him a half days of time, a special trip to Durango and material. All of this was done at their cost. Majestic Marble is an ethical, fair, communicative outfit, I HIGHLY recommend. We ended up with a gorgeous shower surround for a fraction of the price of tile. Pics attached, it looks even better with the dust wiped off.

items.name: Tessy F.
items.text: I was admiring the beautiful marble work at my house this morning, and contemplating the artistry that goes into the mixing and realized that I hadn’t fully appreciated it until now. These guys do fantastic work and I’m super grateful for them. Dennis is awesome! Thanks for creating my dream masterbath and so many other works of art that make my home look like I dreamt it would.

items.name: vivalajay
items.text: Dennis does beautiful work. He is reliable, friendly, and professional. He did one tub and one shower surround for us. Definitely would recommend!

service_area.h2: Marble Shower Surrounds Around Farmington, NM
service_area.text: Majestic Marble works from its shop at 2801 La Plata Hwy in Farmington, New Mexico, and installs on site in customers' homes. Google lists Farmington as its location and no wider service area is published. If you live outside town, call to ask whether your project is within reach before you plan a visit to see samples at the shop.

faq.h2: Questions About Marble Showers and Tubs

items.a: Google lists the shop as open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Installs happen on site in customers' homes, so call (505) 326-2447 before you stop by to make sure someone is in to show you samples.

Reviewers describe marble shower surrounds, tub surrounds, shower pans cast to fit, and a full master bathroom. Majestic Marble is listed on Google as a marble contractor. If you are thinking about another piece, such as a vanity top, call and ask whether it is something the shop makes.

items.q: Does it cost less than a tile shower?
items.a: One customer wrote that they ended up with a gorgeous shower surround for a fraction of the price of tile. Prices are not published and every bathroom is different, so call for a quote on your own shower or tub and compare it with any tile bids you have.

items.q: What if my walls are not square?
items.a: It happens in a lot of houses. On one job the shower walls were out of square and the subfloor had high and low spots. Dennis cast a new pan to fit at the shop's own cost instead of filling the gaps with caulk. Mention any known problems when you call.

items.q: Do you offer free estimates or a warranty?
items.a: Free estimates, warranty terms and licence details are not published on Google or Facebook, so ask when you call. Dennis consults on the phone and you can see samples at the shop, which is a good way to start before you get a price.

final_cta.h2: See Samples and Plan Your New Shower
final_cta.text: Call the shop or stop by La Plata Hwy on a weekday.
